_why: These four patterns are the only thing standing between a resolvable annotation and a fabricated one. BRENDA is the cautionary case: its namespace covers EC NUMBERS ONLY (sample 1.1.1.1), so a BRENDA reference id such as 649716 has no identifiers.org form at all. Assuming otherwise would have emitted https://identifiers.org/brenda:649716 -- a machine-actionable-looking URI that resolves to nothing.

brenda.name: BRENDA
brenda._note: EC numbers ONLY. NOT reference ids. See _why.

combine.specifications.name: COMBINE specifications
combine.specifications._note: Used for the FORMAT of each entry in a COMBINE archive manifest, not for citing anything -- so it is not mintable. Captured here so check_identifier_patterns_fresh.py watches a pattern the archive writer depends on.
